evidence_quotes.O: Creative portraits shot at f1.2 are like no other, this lens is like a studio in a box.
evidence_quotes.C: When I first got this I had still owned my 50mm 1.4, so I did a fairly extensive side-by-side test.
evidence_quotes.E: Don't toy with the 24-105mm, the f/4 series of lenses is very good, but they're not WHOA.
evidence_quotes.A: OK, revelation for the day: YOU DON'T HAVE TO BUY IT HERE. WOW! What a concept! I would think that was obvious.
evidence_quotes.N: BUT, THE AUTO FOCUS... hunting, hunting, driving me nuts. I knew f1.2 lenses have that as part of their physics, but it did get annoying.
